title: Entry machine records would be kept for ever, and erasing a member would not reach them
what: The entry machine feature (built, not switched on yet) keeps every finger or face punch, each member's machine number, and the machine's finished job list, which carries the member's name and plan dates. Nothing ever deletes a punch or a finished job, and erasing or archiving a member does not remove their punches or machine number. Only removing the whole machine or deleting the whole gym clears them.
expected: Punches and finished machine jobs have a stated end date and a clean-up, and erasing a member also removes their machine number and punches.
who: members of gyms that will use an entry machine
how_often: every punch, once the feature is switched on
fix_line: Add a nightly clean-up for old punches and finished jobs, and remove a member's machine number and punches when the member is erased, before switching entry machines on.

title: The privacy notice says nothing about entry machine punches
what: Once entry machines are switched on, MettleUp's server will store each member's door punches (time, machine, how they were checked) and send their name and plan dates to the machine. The privacy notice has no line about entry machines: not what is kept, not who sees it, not how long. It only mentions gym machine use for busy machines, which is a different thing.
expected: Before entry machines go live, the privacy notice (English and Hindi) says what punch records MettleUp keeps for the gym, for how long, and how a member gets them erased.
who: members of gyms that will use an entry machine
how_often: from the day entry machines are switched on
fix_line: Add an entry machine line to the privacy notice and its keep-for table, in both languages, before switching the feature on.

items.reason: All 4 promises kept. Branch receipt prefix: the server gives each new branch its own code, unique in the business, and refuses a receipt without it. Demo gym: the gym server is refused, other sites are refused, browser storage is held in page memory only. Owner-only machines: add and remove check the owner role on the server (the server part is not applied yet). Records only in this browser: the move banner shows it only when the browser copy holds a real gym's records.

Notice: entry machine punches are not in the notice (02). Purpose and consent: desk online payments pass name, mobile and amount to the gym's payment company, as the notice says; the branch visitor look-up returns first name only and is limited to 30 an hour. Deletion: entry machine records are not reached by a member erase (01). Breach timing and children: nothing in this area holds a step or record for either.

No MettleUp staff read path in this area: these screens are used by the gym's own owner and desk, the demo uses made-up data in page memory, and the machine tables are open only to the entry machine server key, never to anon or signed-in users.

Entry machine punches and finished machine jobs have no end date and no clean-up (01). Unknown machine serials are capped at 5000 rows; branch look-up counts are cleared after a day. Deleted records kept on the server are already FN-L4-panel-auth-data-02 (another area).

Outside sends here: the desk's pay-online request goes to the gym's own payment company with name, mobile and amount, matching the notice. The WhatsApp button only opens the desk's own WhatsApp with the pay link; MettleUp sends nothing. The move to the new address carries only the sign-in key to MettleUp's own new address. No AI, analytics, Health Connect, Google Health or Fitbit in this area; the demo blocks every other site.

Gym delete clears every machine table (each tied to the gym and removed with it), and removing a machine clears its jobs and punches. A member erase does not reach the member's machine number or punches (01). Backups are not in this area. Live deletes not run.
